name: Message Item Condition 2 Code
definition: Rule to apply for the presence of a message item.

CFVL.name: Configured Value
CFVL.definition: Message item must be present with the configured value.

DFLT.name: Default Value
DFLT.definition: Message item has the configured value if the item is absent.

ALWV.name: Allowed Values
ALWV.definition: Message item must have one of the configured values.

IFAV.name: If Available
IFAV.definition: Message item has to be present if available.

COPY.name: Copy
COPY.definition: Message item is present if it was present in a previous related message with the same value.

UNSP.name: Not Supported
UNSP.definition: Message item is not supported and has to be absent.

LMNV.name: List Minimum Values
LMNV.definition: Minimum set of values to use in messages.
